rules.rule: Check for urgent foot symptom conditions
rules.problem: Covers all three red-box bullets; trigger 'Finding of foot region' fits 'foot symptoms'. Absent pulse lacks a leg site (see c008).

rules.rule: Check for causes of foot symptoms not needing urgent attention
rules.problem: Covers tinea, generalised (neuropathy, PVD) and localised (heel, bunion) branches. 'Constant ... worse at night' timing for neuropathy is not asked about.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable fracture with foot symptoms
rules.problem: Page: 'Unable to bear weight following injury, fracture likely' -> and(foot finding, unable to weight-bear, injury) is faithful. 'Fracture of bone' is broad, but the page does not restrict the site to the foot (ankle fractures present the same way); 'Fracture of foot' exists if a narrower diagnosis is wanted.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable acute lower limb ischaemia with foot symptoms
rules.problem: Structure and(sudden severe foot pain at rest, or(numbness, weakness, pallor, no pulse)) matches 'with any of the following in the leg'. Pulse lacks a leg finding site.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable critical lower limb ischaemia with foot symptoms
rules.problem: and(claudication, or(rest pain, foot ulcer, foot gangrene)) matches the page.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable tinea pedis from foot skin changes
rules.problem: Interdigital cracks/peeling/scaling as alternatives, and thickened AND scaly skin per site (sole/heel/side) matches the page.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable peripheral neuropathy from foot symptoms
rules.problem: Drops 'constant' and 'worse at night' from the page's symptom description, so the probable diagnosis is broader than the page; otherwise and(generalised foot pain, or(burning, pins/needles, numbness)) is faithful.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable peripheral vascular disease from foot symptoms
rules.problem: and(generalised foot pain, or(muscle pain legs, muscle pain buttocks)) matches the 'Foot pain with muscle pain in legs or buttocks' branch under Generalised foot pain.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable plantar fasciitis from heel pain
rules.problem: 'Worse on starting walking' (start-up pain) encoded as generic 'Pain aggravated by walking', which is broader; no closer SNOMED concept exists.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable bunion from foot deformity
rules.problem: and(foot deformity, bony swelling at 1st MTP joint) matches 'Foot deformity: bony lump at base of big toe'; 'Hallux valgus AND bunion' is the right concept ('Bunion' alone is not an FSN).

rules.rule: Urgent: foot symptoms with fracture or limb ischaemia
rules.problem: Urgent is justified by 'Give urgent attention ... Refer urgently'; or over the three red-box probable diagnoses follows the house pattern.

summary: No invented or wrong content: all 76 conditions trace to the page and every concept resolves. The main imprecision is that the peripheral neuropathy rule drops the page's 'constant ... worse at night' timing, so it fires more broadly. Also, 'no pulse in the leg' is encoded as a site-less 'Peripheral pulse absent', and 'worse on starting walking' as the broader 'Pain aggravated by walking'.
